singular_antecedents.rule: Singular pronoun matches singular antecedent in gender/person

singular_they.policy: Standard contemporary English for epicene / non-binary / generic indefinite antecedents
singular_they.syntactic_agreement: Takes plural verb agreement ('they are', not 'they is') even when antecedent is singular

ambiguous_antecedents.rule: Flag as ambiguity when multiple same-gender nominals precede pronoun within governing category
ambiguous_antecedents.example_ambiguous: Bob told Jim that he was chosen.
ambiguous_antecedents.correction: Bob told Jim that Jim was chosen (or rewrite direct speech).

binding_principles_chomsky.Principle_A: An anaphor (reflexive/reciprocal: himself, themselves, each other) must be bound in its local domain
binding_principles_chomsky.Principle_B: A pronominal (him, her, them) must be free in its local domain
binding_principles_chomsky.Principle_C: An R-expression (proper name, lexical noun phrase) must be free everywhere
